Formula.Name: AcquisitionAAWBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AcquisitionAAWBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedAquisitionAAW(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.AcquisitionAAW_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: AcquisitionExpenses
Formula.Value: Return InitExpPerPolBEL(t) _ + InitExpPercPremBEL(t) _ + AcquisitionAAWBEL(t)

Formula.Name: AnnuityBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AnnuityBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedAnnuity(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Annuity_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: AnnuityBonusBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AnnuityBonusBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedAnnuityBonus(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.AnnuityBonus_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: AnnuityDeathBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AnnuityDeathBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedAnnuityDeath(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Annuity_Death_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: AnnuityTotalBEL
Formula.Value: Return AnnuityBEL(t) + AnnuityBonusBEL(t)

Formula.Name: BalDate
Formula.Value: 'Return GetBalDate(t - PeriodIF(), SMCoreModel.ValnDate, StepsPY) Return SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)

Formula.Name: Benefits
Formula.Value: Return AnnuityTotalBEL(t)

Formula.Name: CEPCBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CEPCBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedClaimExpPerClaim(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.CEPC_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: CUEntrepo
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return SMCoreModel.Annuity_Death_cover(t) End If

Formula.Name: CU_func
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) > 0 If t < ProjTerm() Return SMCoreModel.Annuity_Death_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t - 1) + SMCoreModel.Annuity_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Apply_To_Annuity_PRO(t - 1) End If Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedClaimPercClaimAmt(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.ClaimExpPercClaimAmt_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: Claims
Formula.Value: Return AnnuityDeathBEL(t)

Formula.Name: Description_input
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.ProductDescription3

Formula.Name: FutureServiceCU
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return FutureServiceCU(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + CU_func(t + 1) End If

Formula.Name: GrossBEL
Formula.Value: Return PremiumsFinal(t) _ + RenewalExpenses(t) _ + AcquisitionExpenses(t) _ + Claims(t) _ + Benefits(t)

Formula.Name: Inf_input
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Inf_input()

Formula.Name: InitExpPerPolBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return InitExpPerPolBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedInitExpensePP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.InitialExpensePP_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: InitExpPercPremBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return InitExpPercPremBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedInitExpPerPrem(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: NOM_input
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.NOM_input()

Formula.Name: PPEBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PPEBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedPPE(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.PPE_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PercCUexpenseBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PercCUexpenseBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedPercCUExpense(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.PercCUExpense_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PercPremExpenseBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PercPremExpenseBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedPercPremExpense(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.PercPremiumExpense_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PeriodIF
Formula.Value:
'Return DateSpan.TermInMonths(SMCoreModel.CoverStartDate, SMCoreModel.ValuationDate)
Return SMCoreModel.PeriodIF()

Formula.Name: PremiumsBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PremiumsBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.ExpectedPremiums(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Premiums_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PremiumsFinal
Formula.Value: Return PremiumsBEL(t)

Formula.Name: ProjTerm
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.ProjTerm

Formula.Name: RIAnnuityBEL
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIAnnuityBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.AnnuityRIRecoveries(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RIAnnuityDeathBEL
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIAnnuityDeathBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMAnnuityModelCF.AnnuityDeathRIRecoveries(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RICU
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return SMCoreModel.AnnuityDeathRICover(t) * SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.AnnuityRICover(t) * SMCoreModel.Apply_To_Annuity_PRO(t) End If

Formula.Name: RIFutureServiceCU
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIFutureServiceCU(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + RICU(t) End If

Formula.Name: RenewalExpenses
Formula.Value: Return PPEBEL(t) _ + PercPremExpenseBEL(t) _ + PercCUexpenseBEL(t) _ + CEPCBEL(t) _ + ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL(t)

Formula.Name: ValMonth
Formula.Value: Return t - PeriodIF()

Formula.Name: fnRiskDiscountRate
Formula.Value: If t <= ProjTerm() If SMCoreModel.NonUnit_discount_perc_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate Then Return (1 + SMCoreModel.NonUnit_discount_perc + SMCoreModel.Investment_expense_perc + SMCoreModel.Int_margin_ind * SMCoreModel.Int_margin_val) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 Else Return (1 + Economic_curves.Value(Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t)), SMCoreModel.NOM_input()) + SMCoreModel.Investment_expense_perc + SMCoreModel.Int_margin_ind * SMCoreModel.Int_margin_val) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 End If End If
